clue.text: One Greek character looks after money for those in a swing state

blocks.note: M is the abbreviation for money
the Roman numeral for one
a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man keeps an eye on the cash for voters in a closely fought American state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After money' places the rest after the money letter, so that piece comes first. Michigan is a US swing state, whose residents call themselves Michiganders.
explanation.definitionFit: Michiganders are the residents of Michigan, an American state that regularly flips between the two parties in elections.

explanation.definitionFit: A cat cries out when it wants a saucer of milk, so mewing is its way of asking.
